# AI try-on video from a flat-lay photo — Bria Virtual Try-On and Kling 4

**A flat-lay clothing photo becomes a model wearing it and 5 s fit-check clips (turn, walk, mirror selfie) with size captions.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_b7847d18f90a.webp" alt="A model in a cream striped cardigan, white tee and light jeans does a fit-check turn in a bright bedroom." width="480"></p>

Turns a flat-lay or product photo of clothing into a try-on video on varg: clean the garment photo, dress a model photo in it with Bria Virtual Try-On (or a Nano Banana / GPT Image edit for harder garments), keep the same model across shots, then animate fit-check motions that sell clothes (slow turn, tug and let fall, walk to camera, mirror selfie, fabric close-up) on Kling 4 or Seedance 2.5 with the garment kept intact, and add size captions so the fit is honest. Use when a fashion or apparel seller (Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, dropshipping) asks for a try-on video, "my clothes on a model", an AI model wearing their product, a fit-check or outfit video, a try-on haul, or virtual try-on from flat-lays. Not for accessories that need no body (use product-photo-to-video) or for consistent characters across a story (varg-character-design).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-tryon-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-tryon-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 15 s 9:16 try-on video ad |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.04 per try-on still, ~$0.79 per 5 s Kling 4 clip (tested) |
| Uses | varg API, Bria Virtual Try-On, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Put the cardigan in ./flatlay.jpg on a model and make a 15-second fit-check video for TikTok"
- "Make a try-on haul of these three dresses on the same model, with a 'Model 170 cm, wears M' caption"
- "Turn my hoodie product photo into a mirror-selfie try-on clip, 9:16"
